Name: Lumisteria Missing Hats Bundles
Author: Lumisteria
Description:
This mod adds several small bundles to complete, for fun. Find the missing hats of the villagers! This mod was made for the Stardew Discord "Hat Mouse Summer Fashion" Event.

The bundles can be found in various places of Stardew Valley, after you received the mail from Hat Mouse. Junimos and Hat Mouse are joining efforts to find, repair or recraft the hats of villagers. Bring items to help them!

Version 1.1.0
Two more bundles (Gus and Wizard)
Some letters to go with completion of the bundles
One Conversation Topic for Vincent's Hat, adding a dialogue line for Jodi
French translation


This mod is mainly aimed as fun mod to enjoy [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/17265]Unlockable Bundles[/url]'s features and rewards will not be of the Community Center scale. But depending of your playstyle, some may offer a nice boost.

Explore the valley to find where the bundles are located. Help the Junimo by bringing them items. Enjoy the cameos of Stardew Valley discord. Get rewards upon bundles completion.

The bundles tiles will appears in vanilla places where they shouldn't cause issue : however mods may change that. You are welcome to let me know about compat issue but also understand that it may be a lot of effort to make compat patches. I suggest using mods like noclip if needed, and remember that the bundles tiles will disappears when completed :)
